cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: BuildMate AI combines civil engineering inspection workflows with offline AI and computer vision capabilities to assist engineers and infrastructure inspectors.

test_prompts.prompt: Inspect this construction site observation and produce a concise professional engineering inspection report identifying the defect, likely cause, severity, recommended corrective action, and priority.
Analyze this construction site observation and identify the main safety or quality risks, explain why they matter, and recommend practical corrective actions for the site team.
